items.title: Dianne Reeves interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Clinton, New York, October 13, 2001
items.q: my cousin George Duke is an impeccable musician.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was amazing because, well first of all, and I have to brag, my cousin George Duke is an impeccable musician. He’s someone that if he needed to conduct the orchestra he could have done that, if he needed to run the board recording equipment he could have done that. He was there and he really, really made sure that the sound, everything, the approach, the spirit in the room was right. We had these incredible string musicians there who didn’t know what the project was about and one came to me and says, “You…
Impeccable arrangements. Really creative. You know people are always talking about trying to make the strings swing? Well someone did there.
